newsitem.title: USA: Jason sees Q3 results near 1996.
newsitem.headline: Jason sees Q3 results near 1996.

text.p: Jason Inc, a diversified manufacturing company, said Thursday it expects third quarter results to be similar to those in 1996 and fourth quarter results to be "substantially ahead" of last year.

The company reported net income of $2.3 million or $0.11 a share for the 1996 third quarter on revenues of $106.7 million. The company reported fourth quarter net income of $1.1 million, or $0.05 a share, on revenues of $121.0 million.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported second quarter net income of $3.3 million or $0.16 a share, compared to $2.9 million or $0.14 a share a year ago.
